summary: Larimar Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results and operational highlights. The company announced positive longer-term open-label study data for nomlabofusp, noted a rolling BLA submission underway with completion expected in 2H 2026, and guided to first patient dosing in a Phase 3 study in Q3 2026. Cash position was $156.3 million. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate action was disclosed; this is a routine earnings and business update.
